author: N6rL
content: Adding rusqlite (bundled feature) to Cargo.toml. New module: alcanzai-core/src/sqlite_library.rs with SqliteLibrary struct, open() + open_in_memory() constructors, and inline migration runner (schema_meta version table + MIGRATIONS slice). New error variants: LibraryError::Database (from rusqlite::Error) and LibraryError::Serialization (for internal JSON serialization failures, distinct from Deserialization which is for the RawDocument membrane). Unit tests: verify all tables exist in :memory: DB, verify UNIQUE constraints on content_hash/doi/arxiv_id, verify migration idempotency.
